messages:
anna_support: FYI customer acme-app reported p99 spike ~12:32 UTC with intermittent 502s, started after invoice cycle burst. attaching their repro curl and sample headers.

anna_support: curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input":"ping"}'

anna_support: They say p95 jumped from 180ms -> 2.6s and p99 to 7s. Only for Dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-dedicated-42' for ~15m.

raj_oncall: looking. any obvious auth errors?

anna_support: No 401s. Mostly 502 + a few 504s. Logs show attach timeout and a flurry of attach-retries.

matt_sre: Can you paste the scaleup timeline from the attach logs? I want timestamps for pool attach + GPU warmup.

anna_support: pasted below (trimmed):
```
12:31:58 attach request queued (fairshare priority: normal)
12:32:05 attach -> provision request sent to infra
12:32:15 attach failed: handshake timeout
12:32:16 attach retry x3
12:32:30 attach succeeded -> cold GPU init (kv-cache miss)
12:32:45 first token served
```

carla_platform: That looks like a classic fairshare preemption + image-pull delay combo. During billing window we saw a lot of priority churn. eu-west-2 had limited spare GPUs.

matt_sre: Also note the cold GPU init step with kv-cache miss — first token served at +45s, matches customer's p99. We had a correlated surge in kernel-image pulls at 12:31-12:33 per registry metrics.

raj_oncall: Any auth-service throttles? auth svc shows short 429 bursts around 12:32 which caused attach coordinator to retry slower.

anna_support: Customer says they didn’t change traffic pattern; looks like a platform-side event. They want mitigation now.

carla_platform: For immediate mitigation: 1) bump min-pool for that dedicated pool by +2 GPUs for next 10m, 2) pin a subset of priority customers to hotpool, 3) temporarily relax fairshare eviction for ongoing attaches. We can run the hotpatch now.

matt_sre: I'll run a scoped hotpatch: increase min-pool and disable image-pull backoff for eu-west-2-dedicated-42. On it.

deploy-bot: @matt_sre initiated pool-scale action: increase-min-pool eu-west-2-dedicated-42 -> +2 (request id: scale-41321-01)

matt_sre: Done. Watching metrics. auth 429s subsided after we throttled non-priority token refreshes; attach retries dropped. p95 back to ~220ms after 60s. p99 trending down.

anna_support: Customer confirmed degraded but recovering. They still see occasional 502s on heavy payloads.

carla_platform: Next steps (postmortem): - investigate kernel-image pull spike (registry throttling?) - evaluate proactive warmup for invoice windows - add a short-circuit path for priority attaches to bypass fairshare queue - add an alert when auth 429s cause attach latency > 500ms

matt_sre: I'll open infra ticket with image-registry team and add a short-term mitigation playbook entry.

raj_oncall: For support playbook: if p99 > 3s and pool is dedicated -> immediately bump min-pool by 1-3 depending on traffic, enable hotpool routing for affected customers, and notify infra.

anna_support: Filed customer update. They appreciated the fast response. Marking this thread for follow-up in 24h. :thumbsup:

carla_platform: I'll own the postmortem. Assigning to infra/image-registry and runtime warmup owners.

matt_sre: attaching quick repro steps for SRE runbook:
```
1) curl -v with priority header: X-Redwood-Priority: normal
2) simulate attach spike using loadgen against eu-west-2-dedicated-42
3) watch attach queue depth: /internal/attach/metrics
4) trigger scaleup hotpatch: /ops/scaleup --pool eu-west-2-dedicated-42 --min +2
```

anna_support: Thread closed for now. Will reopen if customer sees regression.

customer-bot: Sent automated incident note to customer Slack channel: "We've applied temporary capacity increase and are monitoring — will follow up with root cause."
